class SALTLinear(nn.Module):
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    r"""
    Linear projection layer with Fisher-weighted SVD initialization,
    attention-aware singular value modulation (\gamma), and low-rank residual branch (A B).

    Formulation:
        $$W = U_{:, :r} \operatorname{diag}(\Sigma_{1:r} \odot \gamma) V_{1:r, :}^\top + A B$$
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        in_features: int,
        out_features: int,
        rank: int = 16,
        original_weight: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        original_bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        fisher_diag: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        use_fisher: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features: int = in_features
        self.out_features: int = out_features
        self.rank: int = min(rank, min(in_features, out_features))
        self.use_fisher: bool = use_fisher

        target_dev = original_weight.device if original_weight is not None else None
        target_dtype = original_weight.dtype if original_weight is not None else torch.float32

        if original_weight is not None:
            W = original_weight.float()
        else:
            W = torch.randn(out_features, in_features) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(in_features))

        # Fisher-weighted SVD
        if use_fisher and fisher_diag is not None and fisher_diag.shape[0] == in_features:
            scale = torch.sqrt(fisher_diag.float().clamp(min=1e-6) + 1e-6)
            # Normalize scale to avoid extreme values
            scale = scale / (scale.norm() / math.sqrt(in_features) + 1e-8)
            W_white = W * scale.unsqueeze(0)
        else:
            scale = None
            W_white = W

        U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W_white, full_matrices=False)

        # Unwhiten Vt
        if scale is not None:
            Vt_unw = Vt / scale.unsqueeze(0)
        else:
            Vt_unw = Vt

        r = self.rank

        self.register_buffer("U", U[:, :r].contiguous().to(device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype))
        self.register_buffer(
            "Vt", Vt_unw[:r, :].contiguous().to(device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.register_buffer("S", S[:r].contiguous().to(device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype))

        self.register_buffer(
            "U_init", U[:, :r].contiguous().to(device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.register_buffer(
            "Vt_init",
            Vt_unw[:r, :].contiguous().to(device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype),
        )
        self.register_buffer("S_init", S[:r].contiguous().to(device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype))

        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(r, device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype))
        self.A = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(out_features, r, device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype))
        self.B = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(r, in_features, device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype))

        if original_bias is not None:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(
                original_bias.clone().to(device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype)
            )
        else:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(
                torch.zeros(out_features, device=target_dev, dtype=target_dtype)
            )

    def init_gamma_from_sensitivity(self, sensitivity: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> None:
        """
        Initialize gamma from attention sensitivity per SVD direction.
        If sensitivity is None, initialize to ones.
        """
        if sensitivity is not None and sensitivity.shape[0] == self.rank:
            s_norm = sensitivity / (sensitivity.mean() + 1e-8)
            self.gamma.data.copy_(
                torch.sqrt(s_norm.clamp(0.1, 10.0)).to(
                    dtype=self.gamma.dtype, device=self.gamma.device
                )
            )
        else:
            self.gamma.data.fill_(1.0)

    def merge_to_linear(self) -> nn.Linear:
        """
        Merge SVD + gamma + LoRA into a single nn.Linear.
        After this, the layer has no LoRA overhead at inference.
        """
        with torch.no_grad():
            adapted_S = (self.S * self.gamma).to(self.U.dtype)
            W = (self.U * adapted_S.unsqueeze(0)) @ self.Vt
            W = W + self.A.to(self.U.dtype) @ self.B.to(self.U.dtype)
            bias = self.bias.clone() if self.bias is not None else None

        new_linear = nn.Linear(
            self.in_features,
            self.out_features,
            bias=bias is not None,
            device=W.device,
            dtype=W.dtype,
        )
        new_linear.weight.data.copy_(W.to(new_linear.weight.dtype))
        if bias is not None:
            new_linear.bias.data.copy_(bias.to(new_linear.bias.dtype))
        return new_linear

    @property
    def weight(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Reconstructed effective weight matrix (out_features, in_features)."""
        adapted_S = (self.S * self.gamma).to(self.U.dtype)
        W_svd = (self.U * adapted_S.unsqueeze(0)) @ self.Vt
        W_lora = self.A.to(self.U.dtype) @ self.B.to(self.U.dtype)
        return W_svd + W_lora

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        r"""Compute adapted linear projection efficiently in low-rank factorized form."""
        adapted_S = (self.S * self.gamma).to(dtype=x.dtype)
        # SVD branch: (x @ Vt.T) * adapted_S @ U.T
        x_vt = F.linear(x, self.Vt.to(dtype=x.dtype))
        x_svd = F.linear(x_vt * adapted_S, self.U.to(dtype=x.dtype))
        # LoRA branch: (x @ B.T) @ A.T
        x_lora = F.linear(F.linear(x, self.B.to(dtype=x.dtype)), self.A.to(dtype=x.dtype))
        out = x_svd + x_lora
        if self.bias is not None:
            out = out + self.bias.to(dtype=x.dtype)
        return out

    def freeze_base_weights(self) -> None:
        """Buffers U, S, Vt are non-trainable by construction. Gamma and A, B remain trainable."""
        pass

Base class for all neural network modules.

Your models should also subclass this class.

Modules can also contain other Modules, allowing them to be nested in a tree structure. You can assign the submodules as regular attributes::

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(1, 20, 5)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(20, 20, 5)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
        return F.relu(self.conv2(x))

Submodules assigned in this way will be registered, and will also have their parameters converted when you call :meth:to, etc.

Note

As per the example above, an __init__() call to the parent class must be made before assignment on the child.

:ivar training: Boolean represents whether this module is in training or evaluation mode. :vartype training: bool

def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    r"""Compute adapted linear projection efficiently in low-rank factorized form."""
    adapted_S = (self.S * self.gamma).to(dtype=x.dtype)
    # SVD branch: (x @ Vt.T) * adapted_S @ U.T
    x_vt = F.linear(x, self.Vt.to(dtype=x.dtype))
    x_svd = F.linear(x_vt * adapted_S, self.U.to(dtype=x.dtype))
    # LoRA branch: (x @ B.T) @ A.T
    x_lora = F.linear(F.linear(x, self.B.to(dtype=x.dtype)), self.A.to(dtype=x.dtype))
    out = x_svd + x_lora
    if self.bias is not None:
        out = out + self.bias.to(dtype=x.dtype)
    return out

Compute adapted linear projection efficiently in low-rank factorized form.

def init_gamma_from_sensitivity(self, sensitivity: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> None:
    """
    Initialize gamma from attention sensitivity per SVD direction.
    If sensitivity is None, initialize to ones.
    """
    if sensitivity is not None and sensitivity.shape[0] == self.rank:
        s_norm = sensitivity / (sensitivity.mean() + 1e-8)
        self.gamma.data.copy_(
            torch.sqrt(s_norm.clamp(0.1, 10.0)).to(
                dtype=self.gamma.dtype, device=self.gamma.device
            )
        )
    else:
        self.gamma.data.fill_(1.0)

def merge_to_linear(self) -> nn.Linear:
    """
    Merge SVD + gamma + LoRA into a single nn.Linear.
    After this, the layer has no LoRA overhead at inference.
    """
    with torch.no_grad():
        adapted_S = (self.S * self.gamma).to(self.U.dtype)
        W = (self.U * adapted_S.unsqueeze(0)) @ self.Vt
        W = W + self.A.to(self.U.dtype) @ self.B.to(self.U.dtype)
        bias = self.bias.clone() if self.bias is not None else None

    new_linear = nn.Linear(
        self.in_features,
        self.out_features,
        bias=bias is not None,
        device=W.device,
        dtype=W.dtype,
    )
    new_linear.weight.data.copy_(W.to(new_linear.weight.dtype))
    if bias is not None:
        new_linear.bias.data.copy_(bias.to(new_linear.bias.dtype))
    return new_linear

@ATTENTION_REGISTRY.register("svd_compressed", supports_causal=True, supports_gqa=True)
class SVDCompressedAttention(BaseAttention):
    r"""Multi-head attention with truncated SVD projections, trainable LoRA adapters,
    GQA support, RoPE support, and optional sparse residuals.
    """

    supports_gqa: bool = True
    is_custom_attention: bool = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: Any | None = None,
        old_attn: Any | None = None,
        dropout: float = 0.1,
        layer_idx: int = 0,
        ranks: dict[str, int] | None = None,
        lora_rank: int = 16,
        lora_alpha: float = 32.0,
        is_decoder: bool | None = None,
        add_sparse: bool = False,
        sparsity_level: float = 0.7,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        model_config = config or kwargs.get("model_config")
        super().__init__(model_config)
        # 1. Dimensions & Architecture
        self.hidden_size: int = int(
            _cfg_get(model_config, "hidden_size", kwargs.get("hidden_size", 768))
        )
        self.num_heads: int = int(
            _cfg_get(
                model_config,
                "num_attention_heads",
                _cfg_get(model_config, "num_heads", kwargs.get("num_attention_heads", 12)),
            )
        )
        self.head_dim: int = int(
            _cfg_get(
                model_config,
                "head_dim",
                kwargs.get(
                    "head_dim",
                    self.hidden_size // self.num_heads if self.num_heads > 0 else 64,
                ),
            )
        )

        cfg_kv = _cfg_get(
            model_config,
            "num_key_value_heads",
            _cfg_get(model_config, "num_kv_heads", None),
        )
        if cfg_kv is not None:
            self.num_kv_heads = int(cfg_kv)
        elif kwargs.get("num_kv_heads") is not None:
            self.num_kv_heads = int(kwargs["num_kv_heads"])
        else:
            self.num_kv_heads = self.num_heads

        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, min(self.num_kv_heads, self.num_heads))
        self.kv_repeat: int = max(1, self.num_heads // self.num_kv_heads)
        self.kv_head_size: int = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
        self.q_head_size: int = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
        self.all_head_size: int = self.q_head_size

        # 2. Causal decoder flag detection
        if is_decoder is not None:
            self.is_decoder = bool(is_decoder)
        else:
            _mt = str(_cfg_get(model_config, "model_type", "") or "").lower()
            self.is_decoder = (
                bool(_cfg_get(model_config, "is_decoder", False))
                or any(
                    _mt.startswith(p)
                    for p in (
                        "gpt",
                        "qwen",
                        "llama",
                        "mistral",
                        "falcon",
                        "bloom",
                        "opt",
                    )
                )
                or (old_attn is not None and hasattr(old_attn, "c_attn"))
            )

        self.is_nested_encoder: bool = False
        default_r = int(kwargs.get("rank", _cfg_get(model_config, "svd_rank", _cfg_get(model_config, "rank", 64))))
        default_r = max(1, min(default_r, self.hidden_size, self.all_head_size))
        self.ranks: dict[str, int] = {}
        for k in ("q", "k", "v", "o"):
            val = ranks.get(k, default_r) if ranks else default_r
            self.ranks[k] = max(1, min(int(val), self.hidden_size, self.all_head_size))

        self.add_sparse: bool = add_sparse
        self.sparsity_level: float = sparsity_level
        self.lora_rank = max(
            1,
            min(
                int(lora_rank if lora_rank is not None else 16),
                self.hidden_size,
                self.all_head_size,
            ),
        )
        self.lora_alpha = lora_alpha
        self.scaling = lora_alpha / max(1, self.lora_rank)

        # 3. Factorized projections
        self.q_down = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.ranks["q"], bias=False)
        self.q_up = nn.Linear(self.ranks["q"], self.q_head_size, bias=True)
        self.k_down = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.ranks["k"], bias=False)
        self.k_up = nn.Linear(self.ranks["k"], self.kv_head_size, bias=True)
        self.v_down = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.ranks["v"], bias=False)
        self.v_up = nn.Linear(self.ranks["v"], self.kv_head_size, bias=True)
        self.o_down = nn.Linear(self.q_head_size, self.ranks["o"], bias=False)
        self.o_up = nn.Linear(self.ranks["o"], self.hidden_size, bias=True)

        for mod in [
            self.q_down,
            self.q_up,
            self.k_down,
            self.k_up,
            self.v_down,
            self.v_up,
            self.o_down,
            self.o_up,
        ]:
            if isinstance(mod, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.orthogonal_(mod.weight)
                if mod.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(mod.bias)
                mod.weight.requires_grad = False
                if mod.bias is not None:
                    mod.bias.requires_grad = False

        # 4. Trainable LoRA parameters
        if self.lora_rank > 0:
            self.q_lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.lora_rank, self.hidden_size))
            self.q_lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.q_head_size, self.lora_rank))
            self.k_lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.lora_rank, self.hidden_size))
            self.k_lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.kv_head_size, self.lora_rank))
            self.v_lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.lora_rank, self.hidden_size))
            self.v_lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.kv_head_size, self.lora_rank))
            self.o_lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.lora_rank, self.q_head_size))
            self.o_lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.hidden_size, self.lora_rank))

            for p_a in (self.q_lora_A, self.k_lora_A, self.v_lora_A, self.o_lora_A):
                nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(p_a, a=math.sqrt(5))
            for p_b in (self.q_lora_B, self.k_lora_B, self.v_lora_B, self.o_lora_B):
                nn.init.zeros_(p_b)
        else:
            self.register_parameter("q_lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("q_lora_B", None)
            self.register_parameter("k_lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("k_lora_B", None)
            self.register_parameter("v_lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("v_lora_B", None)
            self.register_parameter("o_lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("o_lora_B", None)

        if add_sparse:
            self.q_sparse_weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.q_head_size, self.hidden_size))
            self.k_sparse_weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.kv_head_size, self.hidden_size))
            self.v_sparse_weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.kv_head_size, self.hidden_size))
            self.o_sparse_weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.hidden_size, self.q_head_size))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("q_sparse_weight", None)
            self.register_parameter("k_sparse_weight", None)
            self.register_parameter("v_sparse_weight", None)
            self.register_parameter("o_sparse_weight", None)

        dropout_p = _cfg_get(
            model_config,
            "dropout",
            _cfg_get(
                model_config,
                "hidden_dropout_prob",
                _cfg_get(model_config, "attention_probs_dropout_prob", dropout),
            ),
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(float(dropout_p) if dropout_p is not None else 0.1)

        src_attn = old_attn or kwargs.get("pretrained_attn")
        src_p = next(src_attn.parameters(), None) if src_attn is not None else None
        target_dtype = kwargs.get("dtype", src_p.dtype if src_p is not None else torch.float32)
        target_device = kwargs.get("device", src_p.device if src_p is not None else None)

        if src_attn is not None:
            self.copy_weights(src_attn)

        if target_device is not None and target_dtype is not None:
            self.to(device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        elif target_device is not None:
            self.to(device=target_device)
        elif target_dtype is not None:
            self.to(target_dtype)

    def _set_factorised_weights(
        self,
        W_tensor: torch.Tensor,
        bias_tensor: torch.Tensor | None,
        down: nn.Linear,
        up: nn.Linear,
        rank: int,
    ) -> None:
        with torch.no_grad():
            W = W_tensor.float()
            d_out, d_in = W.shape
            r = min(rank, d_out, d_in, down.out_features, up.in_features)
            r = max(r, 1)

            U, s, VT = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
            sqrt_s = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(s[:r], min=1e-12))
            down_weight = (sqrt_s.unsqueeze(1) * VT[:r, :]).to(
                device=down.weight.device, dtype=down.weight.dtype
            )
            up_weight = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_s.unsqueeze(0)).to(
                device=up.weight.device, dtype=up.weight.dtype
            )

            down.weight.data.zero_()
            up.weight.data.zero_()
            down.weight.data[:r, :].copy_(down_weight)
            up.weight.data[:, :r].copy_(up_weight)
            if bias_tensor is not None and up.bias is not None:
                up.bias.data.copy_(bias_tensor.to(device=up.bias.device, dtype=up.bias.dtype))

    def copy_weights(self, old_attn: Any) -> None:
        """Robust weight copying from DistilBERT, RoBERTa nested, GPT-2 Conv1D, or Qwen/LLaMA."""
        with torch.no_grad():
            w_q, b_q = None, None
            w_k, b_k = None, None
            w_v, b_v = None, None
            w_o, b_o = None, None

            # Detect nested encoder container or inner self-attention
            src_cls_name = getattr(old_attn, "__class__", type(old_attn)).__name__
            has_out_proj = any(
                hasattr(old_attn, attr)
                for attr in (
                    "dense",
                    "out_proj",
                    "c_proj",
                    "out_lin",
                    "o_proj",
                    "wo",
                    "o",
                    "proj",
                )
            )
            if src_cls_name in ("BertSelfAttention", "RobertaSelfAttention") or (
                hasattr(old_attn, "query") and not has_out_proj
            ):
                self.is_nested_encoder = True

            if hasattr(old_attn, "self") and hasattr(old_attn, "output"):
                self.is_nested_encoder = True
                src = old_attn.self
                if hasattr(old_attn.output, "dense"):
                    w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(old_attn.output.dense)
            else:
                src = old_attn

            # Pattern 1: GPT-2 Fused c_attn
            if hasattr(src, "c_attn") and hasattr(src, "c_proj"):
                c_w, c_b = _unpack_weight_bias(src.c_attn)
                if c_w is not None:
                    if c_w.shape[0] == self.hidden_size and c_w.shape[1] != self.hidden_size:
                        c_w = c_w.t().contiguous()

                    q_dim = self.q_head_size
                    k_dim = self.kv_head_size
                    v_dim = self.kv_head_size

                    w_q = c_w[:q_dim, :]
                    w_k = c_w[q_dim : q_dim + k_dim, :]
                    w_v = c_w[q_dim + k_dim : q_dim + k_dim + v_dim, :]

                    if c_b is not None:
                        b_q = c_b[:q_dim]
                        b_k = c_b[q_dim : q_dim + k_dim]
                        b_v = c_b[q_dim + k_dim : q_dim + k_dim + v_dim]

                out_w, out_b = _unpack_weight_bias(src.c_proj)
                if out_w is not None:
                    if out_w.shape[0] == self.hidden_size and out_w.shape[1] != self.hidden_size:
                        out_w = out_w.t().contiguous()
                    w_o = out_w
                    b_o = out_b

            # Pattern 2: RoBERTa / BERT separate query, key, value
            elif hasattr(src, "query") and hasattr(src, "key") and hasattr(src, "value"):
                w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.query)
                w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.key)
                w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.value)

                if w_o is None:
                    for attr in ("dense", "out_proj", "o_proj"):
                        if hasattr(src, attr):
                            w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(getattr(src, attr))
                            break

            # Pattern 3: Qwen / LLaMA (q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj)
            elif hasattr(src, "q_proj") and hasattr(src, "k_proj") and hasattr(src, "v_proj"):
                w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.q_proj)
                w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.k_proj)
                w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.v_proj)
                if hasattr(src, "o_proj"):
                    w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.o_proj)

            # Pattern 4: DistilBERT (q_lin, k_lin, v_lin, out_lin)
            elif hasattr(src, "q_lin") and hasattr(src, "k_lin") and hasattr(src, "v_lin"):
                w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.q_lin)
                w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.k_lin)
                w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.v_lin)
                if hasattr(src, "out_lin"):
                    w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.out_lin)

            # Fallback: UniversalAdapter
            if w_q is None or w_k is None or w_v is None:
                try:
                    adapter = UniversalAdapter(old_attn)
                    extracted = adapter.extract_qkv_out()
                    if extracted:
                        w_q = extracted.get("q_weight")
                        b_q = extracted.get("q_bias")
                        w_k = extracted.get("k_weight")
                        b_k = extracted.get("k_bias")
                        w_v = extracted.get("v_weight")
                        b_v = extracted.get("v_bias")
                        if w_o is None:
                            w_o = extracted.get("out_weight")
                            b_o = extracted.get("out_bias")
                except Exception as e:
                    log.debug("UniversalAdapter fallback failed: %s", e)

            # Verification of essential projections
            missing = []
            if w_q is None:
                missing.append("query/q_proj")
            if w_k is None:
                missing.append("key/k_proj")
            if w_v is None:
                missing.append("value/v_proj")
            if missing:
                log.warning("Failed to extract required projections: %s", missing)
                return

            # Frobenius norm checks
            for name, w in [("w_q", w_q), ("w_k", w_k), ("w_v", w_v)]:
                if torch.norm(w.float(), p="fro").item() < 1e-4:
                    log.warning(f"Copied weight {name} has near-zero Frobenius norm (< 1e-4)")

            # Orient weights if needed
            def _orient(w: torch.Tensor, out_dim: int, in_dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
                if w.shape == (out_dim, in_dim):
                    return w
                if w.shape == (in_dim, out_dim):
                    return w.t().contiguous()
                return w

            w_q = _orient(w_q, self.q_head_size, self.hidden_size)
            # Factorize and set Q
            self._set_factorised_weights(w_q, b_q, self.q_down, self.q_up, self.ranks["q"])

            # Factorize and set K & V with GQA pooling if needed
            if w_k.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size:
                w_k = _orient(w_k, self.kv_head_size, self.hidden_size)
                self._set_factorised_weights(w_k, b_k, self.k_down, self.k_up, self.ranks["k"])
            else:
                rep = max(1, w_k.shape[0] // self.kv_head_size)
                w_k_pooled = (
                    w_k.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim, -1)
                    .mean(dim=1)
                    .view(self.kv_head_size, -1)
                )
                b_k_pooled = (
                    b_k.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim).mean(dim=1).view(-1)
                    if b_k is not None
                    else None
                )
                self._set_factorised_weights(
                    w_k_pooled, b_k_pooled, self.k_down, self.k_up, self.ranks["k"]
                )

            if w_v.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size:
                w_v = _orient(w_v, self.kv_head_size, self.hidden_size)
                self._set_factorised_weights(w_v, b_v, self.v_down, self.v_up, self.ranks["v"])
            else:
                rep = max(1, w_v.shape[0] // self.kv_head_size)
                w_v_pooled = (
                    w_v.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim, -1)
                    .mean(dim=1)
                    .view(self.kv_head_size, -1)
                )
                b_v_pooled = (
                    b_v.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim).mean(dim=1).view(-1)
                    if b_v is not None
                    else None
                )
                self._set_factorised_weights(
                    w_v_pooled, b_v_pooled, self.v_down, self.v_up, self.ranks["v"]
                )

            # Set Out projection if not nested encoder
            if w_o is not None and not self.is_nested_encoder:
                if torch.norm(w_o.float(), p="fro").item() < 1e-4:
                    log.warning("Copied out_proj weight has near-zero Frobenius norm (< 1e-4)")
                w_o = _orient(w_o, self.hidden_size, self.q_head_size)
                self._set_factorised_weights(w_o, b_o, self.o_down, self.o_up, self.ranks["o"])

            # Initialize sparse residuals if enabled
            if self.add_sparse:
                low_rank_q = self.q_up.weight @ self.q_down.weight
                res_q = w_q - low_rank_q
                self.q_sparse_weight.data.copy_(res_q)

                low_rank_k = self.k_up.weight @ self.k_down.weight
                res_k = (w_k if w_k.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size else w_k_pooled) - low_rank_k
                self.k_sparse_weight.data.copy_(res_k)

                low_rank_v = self.v_up.weight @ self.v_down.weight
                res_v = (w_v if w_v.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size else w_v_pooled) - low_rank_v
                self.v_sparse_weight.data.copy_(res_v)

                if w_o is not None and not self.is_nested_encoder:
                    low_rank_o = self.o_up.weight @ self.o_down.weight
                    res_o = w_o - low_rank_o
                    self.o_sparse_weight.data.copy_(res_o)

    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        head_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        encoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        encoder_attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        past_key_value: Any | None = None,
        output_attentions: bool | None = False,
        output_hidden_states: bool | None = False,
        return_dict: bool | None = True,
        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
        B, N, _ = hidden_states.shape
        # Defensive device alignment
        if self.q_down.weight.device != hidden_states.device:
            self.to(device=hidden_states.device)

        is_cross = encoder_hidden_states is not None
        kv_input = encoder_hidden_states if is_cross else hidden_states
        kv_len = kv_input.shape[1]

        def proj_q(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
            if x.device != self.q_down.weight.device:
                x = x.to(self.q_down.weight.device)
            out = self.q_up(self.q_down(x))
            if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.q_lora_A is not None and self.q_lora_B is not None:
                out = out + F.linear(F.linear(x, self.q_lora_A), self.q_lora_B) * self.scaling
            if self.add_sparse and self.q_sparse_weight is not None:
                out = out + F.linear(x, self.q_sparse_weight)
            return out

        def proj_k(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
            if x.device != self.k_down.weight.device:
                x = x.to(self.k_down.weight.device)
            out = self.k_up(self.k_down(x))
            if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.k_lora_A is not None and self.k_lora_B is not None:
                out = out + F.linear(F.linear(x, self.k_lora_A), self.k_lora_B) * self.scaling
            if self.add_sparse and self.k_sparse_weight is not None:
                out = out + F.linear(x, self.k_sparse_weight)
            return out

        def proj_v(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
            if x.device != self.v_down.weight.device:
                x = x.to(self.v_down.weight.device)
            out = self.v_up(self.v_down(x))
            if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.v_lora_A is not None and self.v_lora_B is not None:
                out = out + F.linear(F.linear(x, self.v_lora_A), self.v_lora_B) * self.scaling
            if self.add_sparse and self.v_sparse_weight is not None:
                out = out + F.linear(x, self.v_sparse_weight)
            return out

        def proj_o(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
            if x.device != self.o_down.weight.device:
                x = x.to(self.o_down.weight.device)
            out = self.o_up(self.o_down(x))
            if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.o_lora_A is not None and self.o_lora_B is not None:
                out = out + F.linear(F.linear(x, self.o_lora_A), self.o_lora_B) * self.scaling
            if self.add_sparse and self.o_sparse_weight is not None:
                out = out + F.linear(x, self.o_sparse_weight)
            return out

        # 1. Projections
        Q = (
            proj_q(hidden_states)
            .view(B, N, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
        )
        K = (
            proj_k(kv_input)
            .view(B, kv_len, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
            .transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
        )
        V = (
            proj_v(kv_input)
            .view(B, kv_len, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
            .transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
        )

        # 2. RoPE support
        if position_embeddings is None:
            position_embeddings = kwargs.get("position_embeddings")
        if position_embeddings is not None and not is_cross:
            cos, sin = position_embeddings
            Q, K = apply_rotary_pos_emb(Q, K, cos, sin)

        # 3. GQA expansion
        if self.num_kv_heads < self.num_heads:
            K = repeat_kv(K, self.kv_repeat)
            V = repeat_kv(V, self.kv_repeat)

        # 4. Attention scores in FP32
        scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
        scores = torch.matmul(Q.float(), K.float().transpose(-1, -2).contiguous()) * scale

        # 5. Masking
        if self.is_decoder and not is_cross and N > 1:
            causal_mask = (
                torch.triu(
                    torch.full(
                        (N, kv_len),
                        float("-inf"),
                        device=scores.device,
                        dtype=torch.float32,
                    ),
                    diagonal=1,
                )
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(0)
            )
            scores = scores + causal_mask

        eff_mask = encoder_attention_mask if is_cross else attention_mask
        if eff_mask is not None:
            scores = apply_attention_mask(scores, eff_mask)

        scores = torch.nan_to_num(scores, nan=-1e4, posinf=1e4, neginf=-1e4)
        attn_weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(hidden_states.dtype)
        attn_weights = self.dropout(attn_weights)

        # 6. Safe head_mask application
        if head_mask is not None:
            if head_mask.dim() == 1:
                head_mask = head_mask.view(1, -1, 1, 1)
            elif head_mask.dim() == 2:
                head_mask = head_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(-1)
            elif head_mask.dim() == 3:
                head_mask = head_mask.unsqueeze(-1)
            attn_weights = attn_weights * head_mask

        # 7. Context computation & Head Merge
        context = (
            torch.matmul(attn_weights, V)
            .transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
            .view(B, N, self.all_head_size)
        )
        context = torch.nan_to_num(context, nan=0.0, posinf=1e4, neginf=-1e4)

        # 8. Output projection (bypassed if nested encoder)
        if self.is_nested_encoder:
            output = context
        else:
            output = proj_o(context)

        if output.shape[-1] != hidden_states.shape[-1]:
            if output.shape[-1] < hidden_states.shape[-1]:
                output = F.pad(output, (0, hidden_states.shape[-1] - output.shape[-1]))
            else:
                output = output[..., : hidden_states.shape[-1]]

        return output, (attn_weights if output_attentions else None)

def copy_weights(self, old_attn: Any) -> None:
    """Robust weight copying from DistilBERT, RoBERTa nested, GPT-2 Conv1D, or Qwen/LLaMA."""
    with torch.no_grad():
        w_q, b_q = None, None
        w_k, b_k = None, None
        w_v, b_v = None, None
        w_o, b_o = None, None

        # Detect nested encoder container or inner self-attention
        src_cls_name = getattr(old_attn, "__class__", type(old_attn)).__name__
        has_out_proj = any(
            hasattr(old_attn, attr)
            for attr in (
                "dense",
                "out_proj",
                "c_proj",
                "out_lin",
                "o_proj",
                "wo",
                "o",
                "proj",
            )
        )
        if src_cls_name in ("BertSelfAttention", "RobertaSelfAttention") or (
            hasattr(old_attn, "query") and not has_out_proj
        ):
            self.is_nested_encoder = True

        if hasattr(old_attn, "self") and hasattr(old_attn, "output"):
            self.is_nested_encoder = True
            src = old_attn.self
            if hasattr(old_attn.output, "dense"):
                w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(old_attn.output.dense)
        else:
            src = old_attn

        # Pattern 1: GPT-2 Fused c_attn
        if hasattr(src, "c_attn") and hasattr(src, "c_proj"):
            c_w, c_b = _unpack_weight_bias(src.c_attn)
            if c_w is not None:
                if c_w.shape[0] == self.hidden_size and c_w.shape[1] != self.hidden_size:
                    c_w = c_w.t().contiguous()

                q_dim = self.q_head_size
                k_dim = self.kv_head_size
                v_dim = self.kv_head_size

                w_q = c_w[:q_dim, :]
                w_k = c_w[q_dim : q_dim + k_dim, :]
                w_v = c_w[q_dim + k_dim : q_dim + k_dim + v_dim, :]

                if c_b is not None:
                    b_q = c_b[:q_dim]
                    b_k = c_b[q_dim : q_dim + k_dim]
                    b_v = c_b[q_dim + k_dim : q_dim + k_dim + v_dim]

            out_w, out_b = _unpack_weight_bias(src.c_proj)
            if out_w is not None:
                if out_w.shape[0] == self.hidden_size and out_w.shape[1] != self.hidden_size:
                    out_w = out_w.t().contiguous()
                w_o = out_w
                b_o = out_b

        # Pattern 2: RoBERTa / BERT separate query, key, value
        elif hasattr(src, "query") and hasattr(src, "key") and hasattr(src, "value"):
            w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.query)
            w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.key)
            w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.value)

            if w_o is None:
                for attr in ("dense", "out_proj", "o_proj"):
                    if hasattr(src, attr):
                        w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(getattr(src, attr))
                        break

        # Pattern 3: Qwen / LLaMA (q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj)
        elif hasattr(src, "q_proj") and hasattr(src, "k_proj") and hasattr(src, "v_proj"):
            w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.q_proj)
            w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.k_proj)
            w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.v_proj)
            if hasattr(src, "o_proj"):
                w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.o_proj)

        # Pattern 4: DistilBERT (q_lin, k_lin, v_lin, out_lin)
        elif hasattr(src, "q_lin") and hasattr(src, "k_lin") and hasattr(src, "v_lin"):
            w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.q_lin)
            w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.k_lin)
            w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.v_lin)
            if hasattr(src, "out_lin"):
                w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.out_lin)

        # Fallback: UniversalAdapter
        if w_q is None or w_k is None or w_v is None:
            try:
                adapter = UniversalAdapter(old_attn)
                extracted = adapter.extract_qkv_out()
                if extracted:
                    w_q = extracted.get("q_weight")
                    b_q = extracted.get("q_bias")
                    w_k = extracted.get("k_weight")
                    b_k = extracted.get("k_bias")
                    w_v = extracted.get("v_weight")
                    b_v = extracted.get("v_bias")
                    if w_o is None:
                        w_o = extracted.get("out_weight")
                        b_o = extracted.get("out_bias")
            except Exception as e:
                log.debug("UniversalAdapter fallback failed: %s", e)

        # Verification of essential projections
        missing = []
        if w_q is None:
            missing.append("query/q_proj")
        if w_k is None:
            missing.append("key/k_proj")
        if w_v is None:
            missing.append("value/v_proj")
        if missing:
            log.warning("Failed to extract required projections: %s", missing)
            return

        # Frobenius norm checks
        for name, w in [("w_q", w_q), ("w_k", w_k), ("w_v", w_v)]:
            if torch.norm(w.float(), p="fro").item() < 1e-4:
                log.warning(f"Copied weight {name} has near-zero Frobenius norm (< 1e-4)")

        # Orient weights if needed
        def _orient(w: torch.Tensor, out_dim: int, in_dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
            if w.shape == (out_dim, in_dim):
                return w
            if w.shape == (in_dim, out_dim):
                return w.t().contiguous()
            return w

        w_q = _orient(w_q, self.q_head_size, self.hidden_size)
        # Factorize and set Q
        self._set_factorised_weights(w_q, b_q, self.q_down, self.q_up, self.ranks["q"])

        # Factorize and set K & V with GQA pooling if needed
        if w_k.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size:
            w_k = _orient(w_k, self.kv_head_size, self.hidden_size)
            self._set_factorised_weights(w_k, b_k, self.k_down, self.k_up, self.ranks["k"])
        else:
            rep = max(1, w_k.shape[0] // self.kv_head_size)
            w_k_pooled = (
                w_k.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim, -1)
                .mean(dim=1)
                .view(self.kv_head_size, -1)
            )
            b_k_pooled = (
                b_k.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim).mean(dim=1).view(-1)
                if b_k is not None
                else None
            )
            self._set_factorised_weights(
                w_k_pooled, b_k_pooled, self.k_down, self.k_up, self.ranks["k"]
            )

        if w_v.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size:
            w_v = _orient(w_v, self.kv_head_size, self.hidden_size)
            self._set_factorised_weights(w_v, b_v, self.v_down, self.v_up, self.ranks["v"])
        else:
            rep = max(1, w_v.shape[0] // self.kv_head_size)
            w_v_pooled = (
                w_v.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim, -1)
                .mean(dim=1)
                .view(self.kv_head_size, -1)
            )
            b_v_pooled = (
                b_v.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim).mean(dim=1).view(-1)
                if b_v is not None
                else None
            )
            self._set_factorised_weights(
                w_v_pooled, b_v_pooled, self.v_down, self.v_up, self.ranks["v"]
            )

        # Set Out projection if not nested encoder
        if w_o is not None and not self.is_nested_encoder:
            if torch.norm(w_o.float(), p="fro").item() < 1e-4:
                log.warning("Copied out_proj weight has near-zero Frobenius norm (< 1e-4)")
            w_o = _orient(w_o, self.hidden_size, self.q_head_size)
            self._set_factorised_weights(w_o, b_o, self.o_down, self.o_up, self.ranks["o"])

        # Initialize sparse residuals if enabled
        if self.add_sparse:
            low_rank_q = self.q_up.weight @ self.q_down.weight
            res_q = w_q - low_rank_q
            self.q_sparse_weight.data.copy_(res_q)

            low_rank_k = self.k_up.weight @ self.k_down.weight
            res_k = (w_k if w_k.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size else w_k_pooled) - low_rank_k
            self.k_sparse_weight.data.copy_(res_k)

            low_rank_v = self.v_up.weight @ self.v_down.weight
            res_v = (w_v if w_v.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size else w_v_pooled) - low_rank_v
            self.v_sparse_weight.data.copy_(res_v)

            if w_o is not None and not self.is_nested_encoder:
                low_rank_o = self.o_up.weight @ self.o_down.weight
                res_o = w_o - low_rank_o
                self.o_sparse_weight.data.copy_(res_o)

@ATTENTION_REGISTRY.register("svd_llm_v2_attention")
class SVDLLMV2Attention(BaseAttention):
    r"""SVD-factorized attention layer with explicit U, Sigma, V^H matrix buffers
    and trainable LoRA recovery adapters.
    """

    supports_gqa: bool = True
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    triton_kernel: str = "low_rank"

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: Any | None = None,
        old_attn: nn.Module | None = None,
        rank: int | None = 192,
        energy_threshold: float = 0.999,
        lora_rank: int = 16,
        lora_alpha: float = 32.0,
        is_decoder: bool | None = None,
        dropout: float = 0.1,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        comp_config = _cfg_get(config, "compression_config", kwargs.get("comp_config"))
        actual_rank = (
            rank
            if rank is not None
            else _cfg_get(
                comp_config,
                "rank",
                _cfg_get(config, "svd_rank", _cfg_get(config, "rank", 192)),
            )
        )
        super().__init__(config, actual_rank)

        # 1. Dimensions & Architecture
        self.hidden_size: int = kwargs.get(
            "hidden_size",
            _cfg_get(
                config,
                "hidden_size",
                _cfg_get(config, "dim", _cfg_get(config, "d_model", 768)),
            ),
        )
        self.num_heads: int = kwargs.get(
            "num_heads",
            kwargs.get(
                "num_attention_heads",
                _cfg_get(
                    config,
                    "num_attention_heads",
                    _cfg_get(config, "num_heads", _cfg_get(config, "n_heads", 12)),
                ),
            ),
        )

        cfg_head_dim = _cfg_get(config, "head_dim", None)
        adapter_head_dim = (
            getattr(getattr(config, "adapter", None), "head_dim", None) if config else None
        )
        inferred_head_dim = kwargs.get("head_dim", cfg_head_dim or adapter_head_dim)
        if inferred_head_dim is None and old_attn is not None:
            for attr in ("q_proj", "query", "q_lin"):
                if hasattr(old_attn, attr):
                    layer_q = getattr(old_attn, attr)
                    if hasattr(layer_q, "weight"):
                        inferred_head_dim = layer_q.weight.shape[0] // self.num_heads
                        break
        self.head_dim: int = int(
            inferred_head_dim
            if inferred_head_dim is not None
            else (self.hidden_size // self.num_heads if self.num_heads > 0 else 64)
        )

        cfg_kv = _cfg_get(config, "num_key_value_heads", _cfg_get(config, "num_kv_heads", None))
        if cfg_kv is not None:
            self.num_kv_heads = int(cfg_kv)
        elif kwargs.get("num_kv_heads") is not None:
            self.num_kv_heads = int(kwargs["num_kv_heads"])
        else:
            self.num_kv_heads = self.num_heads

        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, min(self.num_kv_heads, self.num_heads))
        self.kv_repeat: int = self.num_heads // self.num_kv_heads
        self.kv_head_size: int = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
        self.q_head_size: int = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
        self.all_head_size: int = self.q_head_size

        self.rank: int = actual_rank
        self.energy_threshold: float = energy_threshold
        self.lora_rank: int = _cfg_get(
            config,
            "lora_rank",
            _cfg_get(comp_config, "lora_rank", lora_rank if lora_rank is not None else 16),
        )
        self.lora_alpha: float = _cfg_get(
            config, "lora_alpha", _cfg_get(comp_config, "lora_alpha", lora_alpha)
        )
        self.scaling: float = self.lora_alpha / max(1, self.lora_rank)

        # 2. Causal decoder flag detection
        _mt = str(_cfg_get(config, "model_type", "") or "").lower()
        _decoder_prefixes = (
            "gpt",
            "qwen",
            "llama",
            "mistral",
            "gemma",
            "phi",
            "opt",
            "bloom",
            "falcon",
            "mpt",
        )
        self.is_decoder = (
            bool(_cfg_get(config, "is_decoder", False))
            or bool(_cfg_get(config, "causal", False))
            or any(_mt.startswith(p) for p in _decoder_prefixes)
            or (old_attn is not None and hasattr(old_attn, "c_attn"))
            or bool(kwargs.get("is_causal", False))
        )
        if is_decoder is not None:
            self.is_decoder = bool(is_decoder)

        self.is_nested_encoder: bool = False

        # Device & Dtype detection from old_attn
        src_p = next(old_attn.parameters(), None) if old_attn is not None else None
        target_dtype = kwargs.get("dtype", src_p.dtype if src_p is not None else torch.float32)
        target_device = kwargs.get("device", src_p.device if src_p is not None else None)

        # 3. Create parameter buffers for SVD factors
        self.query_u = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.q_head_size, self.rank, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.query_s = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.rank, device=target_device, dtype=torch.float32)
        )
        self.query_vh = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.rank, self.hidden_size, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.query_bias = nn.Parameter(
            torch.zeros(self.q_head_size, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )

        self.key_u = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.kv_head_size, self.rank, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.key_s = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.rank, device=target_device, dtype=torch.float32))
        self.key_vh = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.rank, self.hidden_size, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.key_bias = nn.Parameter(
            torch.zeros(self.kv_head_size, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )

        self.value_u = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.kv_head_size, self.rank, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.value_s = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.rank, device=target_device, dtype=torch.float32)
        )
        self.value_vh = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.rank, self.hidden_size, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.value_bias = nn.Parameter(
            torch.zeros(self.kv_head_size, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )

        self.out_proj_u = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.hidden_size, self.rank, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.out_proj_s = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.rank, device=target_device, dtype=torch.float32)
        )
        self.out_proj_vh = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.rank, self.q_head_size, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )
        self.out_proj_bias = nn.Parameter(
            torch.zeros(self.hidden_size, device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)
        )

        # 4. Trainable LoRA Adapters
        if self.lora_rank > 0:
            self.q_lora_A = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    self.lora_rank,
                    self.hidden_size,
                    device=target_device,
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                )
            )
            self.q_lora_B = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    self.q_head_size,
                    self.lora_rank,
                    device=target_device,
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                )
            )
            self.k_lora_A = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    self.lora_rank,
                    self.hidden_size,
                    device=target_device,
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                )
            )
            self.k_lora_B = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    self.kv_head_size,
                    self.lora_rank,
                    device=target_device,
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                )
            )
            self.v_lora_A = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    self.lora_rank,
                    self.hidden_size,
                    device=target_device,
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                )
            )
            self.v_lora_B = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    self.kv_head_size,
                    self.lora_rank,
                    device=target_device,
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                )
            )
            self.out_lora_A = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    self.lora_rank,
                    self.q_head_size,
                    device=target_device,
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                )
            )
            self.out_lora_B = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    self.hidden_size,
                    self.lora_rank,
                    device=target_device,
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                )
            )

            for p_a in (self.q_lora_A, self.k_lora_A, self.v_lora_A, self.out_lora_A):
                nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(p_a, a=math.sqrt(5))
            for p_b in (self.q_lora_B, self.k_lora_B, self.v_lora_B, self.out_lora_B):
                nn.init.zeros_(p_b)
        else:
            self.register_parameter("q_lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("q_lora_B", None)
            self.register_parameter("k_lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("k_lora_B", None)
            self.register_parameter("v_lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("v_lora_B", None)
            self.register_parameter("out_lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("out_lora_B", None)

        self._init_random()

        # Freeze base SVD parameters
        for p in (
            self.query_u,
            self.query_s,
            self.query_vh,
            self.query_bias,
            self.key_u,
            self.key_s,
            self.key_vh,
            self.key_bias,
            self.value_u,
            self.value_s,
            self.value_vh,
            self.value_bias,
            self.out_proj_u,
            self.out_proj_s,
            self.out_proj_vh,
            self.out_proj_bias,
        ):
            p.requires_grad = False

        if old_attn is not None:
            self.copy_weights(old_attn)

        dropout_p = (
            getattr(
                config,
                "dropout",
                getattr(config, "attention_probs_dropout_prob", dropout),
            )
            if config
            else dropout
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_p)
        self.triton_kwargs = {}

        if target_device is not None or target_dtype is not None:
            self.to(device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype)

    def _init_random(self) -> None:
        """Initialize orthogonal factor projections with identity scales."""

        def _ortho(t: nn.Parameter) -> None:
            with torch.no_grad():
                if t.device.type == "cuda" and t.dtype in (
                    torch.float16,
                    torch.bfloat16,
                ):
                    f = torch.empty(t.shape, device=t.device, dtype=torch.float32)
                    nn.init.orthogonal_(f)
                    t.data.copy_(f.to(dtype=t.dtype))
                else:
                    nn.init.orthogonal_(t)

        _ortho(self.query_u)
        nn.init.ones_(self.query_s)
        _ortho(self.query_vh)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.query_bias)

        _ortho(self.key_u)
        nn.init.ones_(self.key_s)
        _ortho(self.key_vh)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.key_bias)

        _ortho(self.value_u)
        nn.init.ones_(self.value_s)
        _ortho(self.value_vh)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_bias)

        _ortho(self.out_proj_u)
        nn.init.ones_(self.out_proj_s)
        _ortho(self.out_proj_vh)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out_proj_bias)

    def _decompose_and_set(
        self,
        u_param: nn.Parameter,
        s_param: nn.Parameter,
        vh_param: nn.Parameter,
        bias_param: nn.Parameter,
        weight: torch.Tensor,
        bias: torch.Tensor | None,
    ) -> None:
        with torch.no_grad():
            W = weight.float()
            if W.shape != (u_param.shape[0], vh_param.shape[1]):
                logger.warning(
                    f"SVDLLMV2 shape mismatch: W={W.shape} vs expected=({u_param.shape[0]}, {vh_param.shape[1]}). Padding/truncating."
                )
                padded_W = torch.zeros(
                    u_param.shape[0], vh_param.shape[1], device=W.device, dtype=W.dtype
                )
                padded_W[
                    : min(u_param.shape[0], W.shape[0]),
                    : min(vh_param.shape[1], W.shape[1]),
                ] = W[
                    : min(u_param.shape[0], W.shape[0]),
                    : min(vh_param.shape[1], W.shape[1]),
                ]
                W = padded_W

            U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W.float(), full_matrices=False)
            total_energy = (S**2).sum().clamp(min=1e-12)
            cum_energy = torch.cumsum(S**2, dim=0) / total_energy
            r_energy = int((cum_energy < self.energy_threshold).sum().item()) + 1
            r = max(1, min(r_energy, self.rank, len(S)))

            u_param.data.zero_()
            s_param.data.zero_()
            vh_param.data.zero_()
            u_param.data[:, :r] = U[:, :r].to(dtype=u_param.dtype, device=u_param.device)
            s_param.data[:r] = S[:r].to(dtype=s_param.dtype, device=s_param.device)
            vh_param.data[:r, :] = Vt[:r, :].to(dtype=vh_param.dtype, device=vh_param.device)
            if bias is not None:
                bias_param.data.copy_(bias.to(dtype=bias_param.dtype, device=bias_param.device))

    def copy_weights(self, old_attn: nn.Module) -> None:
        """Robust weight copying from DistilBERT, RoBERTa nested, GPT-2 Conv1D, or Qwen/LLaMA."""
        with torch.no_grad():
            w_q, b_q = None, None
            w_k, b_k = None, None
            w_v, b_v = None, None
            w_o, b_o = None, None

            src = old_attn
            if hasattr(old_attn, "self") and hasattr(old_attn, "output"):
                src = old_attn.self
                if hasattr(old_attn.output, "dense"):
                    w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(old_attn.output.dense)

            # Pattern 1: GPT-2 Fused c_attn
            if hasattr(src, "c_attn") and hasattr(src, "c_proj"):
                c_attn_w, c_attn_b = _unpack_weight_bias(src.c_attn)
                if c_attn_w is not None:
                    split_size = c_attn_w.size(0) // 3
                    w_q = c_attn_w[:split_size, :]
                    w_k = c_attn_w[split_size : 2 * split_size, :]
                    w_v = c_attn_w[2 * split_size :, :]
                    if c_attn_b is not None:
                        b_q = c_attn_b[:split_size]
                        b_k = c_attn_b[split_size : 2 * split_size]
                        b_v = c_attn_b[2 * split_size :]

                w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.c_proj)

            # Pattern 2: RoBERTa / BERT separate query, key, value
            elif hasattr(src, "query") and hasattr(src, "key") and hasattr(src, "value"):
                w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.query)
                w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.key)
                w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.value)

                if w_o is None:
                    for attr in ("dense", "out_proj", "o_proj"):
                        if hasattr(src, attr):
                            w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(getattr(src, attr))
                            break

            # Pattern 3: Qwen / LLaMA (q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj)
            elif hasattr(src, "q_proj") and hasattr(src, "k_proj") and hasattr(src, "v_proj"):
                w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.q_proj)
                w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.k_proj)
                w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.v_proj)
                if hasattr(src, "o_proj"):
                    w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.o_proj)

            # Pattern 4: DistilBERT (q_lin, k_lin, v_lin, out_lin)
            elif hasattr(src, "q_lin") and hasattr(src, "k_lin") and hasattr(src, "v_lin"):
                w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.q_lin)
                w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.k_lin)
                w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.v_lin)
                if hasattr(src, "out_lin"):
                    w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.out_lin)

            # Fallback: UniversalAdapter
            if w_q is None or w_k is None or w_v is None:
                try:
                    adapter = UniversalAdapter(old_attn)
                    extracted = adapter.extract_qkv_out()
                    if extracted:
                        w_q = extracted.get("q_weight")
                        b_q = extracted.get("q_bias")
                        w_k = extracted.get("k_weight")
                        b_k = extracted.get("k_bias")
                        w_v = extracted.get("v_weight")
                        b_v = extracted.get("v_bias")
                        if w_o is None:
                            w_o = extracted.get("out_weight")
                            b_o = extracted.get("out_bias")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug("UniversalAdapter fallback failed: %s", e)

            # Verification of essential projections
            missing = []
            if w_q is None:
                missing.append("query/q_proj")
            if w_k is None:
                missing.append("key/k_proj")
            if w_v is None:
                missing.append("value/v_proj")
            if missing:
                logger.warning(f"Failed to extract required projections: {missing}")
                return

            # Frobenius norm checks
            for name, w in [("w_q", w_q), ("w_k", w_k), ("w_v", w_v)]:
                if torch.norm(w.float(), p="fro").item() < 1e-4:
                    logger.warning(f"Copied weight {name} has near-zero Frobenius norm (< 1e-4)")

            # Decompose and set Q
            self._decompose_and_set(
                self.query_u, self.query_s, self.query_vh, self.query_bias, w_q, b_q
            )

            # Decompose and set K & V with GQA pooling if needed
            if w_k.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size:
                self._decompose_and_set(
                    self.key_u, self.key_s, self.key_vh, self.key_bias, w_k, b_k
                )
            else:
                rep = w_k.shape[0] // self.kv_head_size
                w_k_pooled = (
                    w_k.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim, -1)
                    .mean(dim=1)
                    .view(self.kv_head_size, -1)
                )
                b_k_pooled = (
                    b_k.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim).mean(dim=1).view(-1)
                    if b_k is not None
                    else None
                )
                self._decompose_and_set(
                    self.key_u,
                    self.key_s,
                    self.key_vh,
                    self.key_bias,
                    w_k_pooled,
                    b_k_pooled,
                )

            if w_v.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size:
                self._decompose_and_set(
                    self.value_u, self.value_s, self.value_vh, self.value_bias, w_v, b_v
                )
            else:
                rep = w_v.shape[0] // self.kv_head_size
                w_v_pooled = (
                    w_v.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim, -1)
                    .mean(dim=1)
                    .view(self.kv_head_size, -1)
                )
                b_v_pooled = (
                    b_v.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim).mean(dim=1).view(-1)
                    if b_v is not None
                    else None
                )
                self._decompose_and_set(
                    self.value_u,
                    self.value_s,
                    self.value_vh,
                    self.value_bias,
                    w_v_pooled,
                    b_v_pooled,
                )

            # Decompose and set Out projection (if not nested encoder)
            if w_o is not None and not self.is_nested_encoder:
                if torch.norm(w_o.float(), p="fro").item() < 1e-4:
                    logger.warning("Copied out_proj weight has near-zero Frobenius norm (< 1e-4)")
                self._decompose_and_set(
                    self.out_proj_u,
                    self.out_proj_s,
                    self.out_proj_vh,
                    self.out_proj_bias,
                    w_o,
                    b_o,
                )

    def _project(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        vh: nn.Parameter,
        s: nn.Parameter,
        u: nn.Parameter,
        b: nn.Parameter,
        lora_A: nn.Parameter | None,
        lora_B: nn.Parameter | None,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Factorized SVD projection with LoRA residual addition."""
        V_eff = s.to(dtype=vh.dtype).view(-1, 1) * vh
        base_out = triton_dispatch(self.triton_kernel, x, u, V_eff, bias=b)
        if self.lora_rank > 0 and lora_A is not None and lora_B is not None:
            lora_out = F.linear(F.linear(x, lora_A), lora_B) * self.scaling
            base_out = base_out + lora_out
        return base_out

    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        head_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        encoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        encoder_attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        past_key_value: Any | None = None,
        output_attentions: bool | None = False,
        output_hidden_states: bool | None = False,
        return_dict: bool | None = True,
        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape
        device = hidden_states.device
        dtype = hidden_states.dtype

        # Defensive device check
        if self.query_u.device != device or self.query_u.dtype != dtype:
            self.to(device=device, dtype=dtype)

        is_cross = encoder_hidden_states is not None
        kv_input = encoder_hidden_states if is_cross else hidden_states
        kv_len = kv_input.shape[1]

        # 1. Factorized linear projections with LoRA
        Q_act = self._project(
            hidden_states,
            self.query_vh,
            self.query_s,
            self.query_u,
            self.query_bias,
            self.q_lora_A,
            self.q_lora_B,
        )
        K_act = self._project(
            kv_input,
            self.key_vh,
            self.key_s,
            self.key_u,
            self.key_bias,
            self.k_lora_A,
            self.k_lora_B,
        )
        V_act = self._project(
            kv_input,
            self.value_vh,
            self.value_s,
            self.value_u,
            self.value_bias,
            self.v_lora_A,
            self.v_lora_B,
        )

        Q = (
            Q_act.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
        )
        K = (
            K_act.view(batch_size, kv_len, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
            .transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
        )
        V = (
            V_act.view(batch_size, kv_len, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
            .transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
        )

        # 2. RoPE support
        if position_embeddings is None:
            position_embeddings = kwargs.get("position_embeddings")
        if position_embeddings is not None and not is_cross:
            cos, sin = position_embeddings
            Q, K = apply_rotary_pos_emb(Q, K, cos, sin)

        # 3. GQA expansion
        if self.num_kv_heads < self.num_heads:
            K = repeat_kv(K, self.kv_repeat)
            V = repeat_kv(V, self.kv_repeat)

        # 4. Attention scores in FP32
        scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
        eff_mask = encoder_attention_mask if is_cross else attention_mask
        if eff_mask is None and head_mask is None and not output_attentions:
            try:
                _qs = Q.half() if Q.dtype == torch.float32 else Q
                _ks = K.half() if K.dtype == torch.float32 else K
                _vs = V.half() if V.dtype == torch.float32 else V
                _is_causal = getattr(self, "is_decoder", False) and not is_cross and seq_len > 1
                _sdpa_out = torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(
                    _qs,
                    _ks,
                    _vs,
                    is_causal=_is_causal,
                    dropout_p=self.dropout.p if self.training else 0.0,
                )
                _sdpa_out = (
                    _sdpa_out.to(hidden_states.dtype)
                    .transpose(1, 2)
                    .contiguous()
                    .view(batch_size, seq_len, self.all_head_size)
                )
                _sdpa_out = torch.nan_to_num(_sdpa_out, nan=0.0, posinf=1e4, neginf=-1e4)
                if self.is_nested_encoder:
                    out = _sdpa_out
                else:
                    out = self._project(
                        _sdpa_out,
                        self.out_proj_vh,
                        self.out_proj_s,
                        self.out_proj_u,
                        self.out_proj_bias,
                        self.out_lora_A,
                        self.out_lora_B,
                    )
                if out.shape[-1] != hidden_states.shape[-1]:
                    if out.shape[-1] < hidden_states.shape[-1]:
                        out = F.pad(out, (0, hidden_states.shape[-1] - out.shape[-1]))
                    else:
                        out = out[..., : hidden_states.shape[-1]]
                return out, None
            except Exception:
                pass

        scores = torch.matmul(Q.float(), K.float().transpose(-2, -1).contiguous()) * scale

        # 5. Masking
        if self.is_decoder and not is_cross and seq_len > 1:
            causal_mask = (
                torch.triu(
                    torch.full(
                        (seq_len, kv_len),
                        float("-inf"),
                        device=scores.device,
                        dtype=torch.float32,
                    ),
                    diagonal=1,
                )
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(0)
            )
            scores = scores + causal_mask

        eff_mask = encoder_attention_mask if is_cross else attention_mask
        if eff_mask is not None:
            if eff_mask.dim() == 2:
                if eff_mask.dtype == torch.bool:
                    scores = scores.masked_fill(~eff_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2), -10000.0)
                elif torch.is_floating_point(eff_mask) and (eff_mask < 0).any():
                    scores = scores + eff_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2).float()
                else:
                    scores = scores + (eff_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2).float() - 1.0) * 10000.0
            elif eff_mask.dim() == 3:
                if eff_mask.dtype == torch.bool:
                    scores = scores.masked_fill(~eff_mask.unsqueeze(1), -10000.0)
                else:
                    scores = scores + eff_mask.unsqueeze(1).float()
            elif eff_mask.dim() == 4:
                if eff_mask.dtype == torch.bool:
                    scores = scores.masked_fill(~eff_mask, -10000.0)
                else:
                    scores = scores + eff_mask.float()

        scores = torch.nan_to_num(scores, nan=-1e4, posinf=1e4, neginf=-1e4)
        probs = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(hidden_states.dtype)
        probs = self.dropout(probs)

        # 6. Safe head_mask application
        if head_mask is not None:
            if head_mask.dim() == 1:
                head_mask = head_mask.view(1, -1, 1, 1)
            elif head_mask.dim() == 2:
                head_mask = head_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(-1)
            elif head_mask.dim() == 3:
                head_mask = head_mask.unsqueeze(-1)
            probs = probs * head_mask

        # 7. Context computation & Head Merge
        context = (
            torch.matmul(probs, V)
            .transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
            .view(batch_size, seq_len, self.all_head_size)
        )
        context = torch.nan_to_num(context, nan=0.0, posinf=1e4, neginf=-1e4)

        # 8. Output projection (bypassed if nested encoder)
        if self.is_nested_encoder:
            out = context
        else:
            out = self._project(
                context,
                self.out_proj_vh,
                self.out_proj_s,
                self.out_proj_u,
                self.out_proj_bias,
                self.out_lora_A,
                self.out_lora_B,
            )

        if out.shape[-1] != hidden_states.shape[-1]:
            if out.shape[-1] < hidden_states.shape[-1]:
                out = F.pad(out, (0, hidden_states.shape[-1] - out.shape[-1]))
            else:
                out = out[..., : hidden_states.shape[-1]]

        return out, (probs if output_attentions else None)

def copy_weights(self, old_attn: nn.Module) -> None:
    """Robust weight copying from DistilBERT, RoBERTa nested, GPT-2 Conv1D, or Qwen/LLaMA."""
    with torch.no_grad():
        w_q, b_q = None, None
        w_k, b_k = None, None
        w_v, b_v = None, None
        w_o, b_o = None, None

        src = old_attn
        if hasattr(old_attn, "self") and hasattr(old_attn, "output"):
            src = old_attn.self
            if hasattr(old_attn.output, "dense"):
                w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(old_attn.output.dense)

        # Pattern 1: GPT-2 Fused c_attn
        if hasattr(src, "c_attn") and hasattr(src, "c_proj"):
            c_attn_w, c_attn_b = _unpack_weight_bias(src.c_attn)
            if c_attn_w is not None:
                split_size = c_attn_w.size(0) // 3
                w_q = c_attn_w[:split_size, :]
                w_k = c_attn_w[split_size : 2 * split_size, :]
                w_v = c_attn_w[2 * split_size :, :]
                if c_attn_b is not None:
                    b_q = c_attn_b[:split_size]
                    b_k = c_attn_b[split_size : 2 * split_size]
                    b_v = c_attn_b[2 * split_size :]

            w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.c_proj)

        # Pattern 2: RoBERTa / BERT separate query, key, value
        elif hasattr(src, "query") and hasattr(src, "key") and hasattr(src, "value"):
            w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.query)
            w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.key)
            w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.value)

            if w_o is None:
                for attr in ("dense", "out_proj", "o_proj"):
                    if hasattr(src, attr):
                        w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(getattr(src, attr))
                        break

        # Pattern 3: Qwen / LLaMA (q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj)
        elif hasattr(src, "q_proj") and hasattr(src, "k_proj") and hasattr(src, "v_proj"):
            w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.q_proj)
            w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.k_proj)
            w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.v_proj)
            if hasattr(src, "o_proj"):
                w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.o_proj)

        # Pattern 4: DistilBERT (q_lin, k_lin, v_lin, out_lin)
        elif hasattr(src, "q_lin") and hasattr(src, "k_lin") and hasattr(src, "v_lin"):
            w_q, b_q = _unpack_weight_bias(src.q_lin)
            w_k, b_k = _unpack_weight_bias(src.k_lin)
            w_v, b_v = _unpack_weight_bias(src.v_lin)
            if hasattr(src, "out_lin"):
                w_o, b_o = _unpack_weight_bias(src.out_lin)

        # Fallback: UniversalAdapter
        if w_q is None or w_k is None or w_v is None:
            try:
                adapter = UniversalAdapter(old_attn)
                extracted = adapter.extract_qkv_out()
                if extracted:
                    w_q = extracted.get("q_weight")
                    b_q = extracted.get("q_bias")
                    w_k = extracted.get("k_weight")
                    b_k = extracted.get("k_bias")
                    w_v = extracted.get("v_weight")
                    b_v = extracted.get("v_bias")
                    if w_o is None:
                        w_o = extracted.get("out_weight")
                        b_o = extracted.get("out_bias")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug("UniversalAdapter fallback failed: %s", e)

        # Verification of essential projections
        missing = []
        if w_q is None:
            missing.append("query/q_proj")
        if w_k is None:
            missing.append("key/k_proj")
        if w_v is None:
            missing.append("value/v_proj")
        if missing:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to extract required projections: {missing}")
            return

        # Frobenius norm checks
        for name, w in [("w_q", w_q), ("w_k", w_k), ("w_v", w_v)]:
            if torch.norm(w.float(), p="fro").item() < 1e-4:
                logger.warning(f"Copied weight {name} has near-zero Frobenius norm (< 1e-4)")

        # Decompose and set Q
        self._decompose_and_set(
            self.query_u, self.query_s, self.query_vh, self.query_bias, w_q, b_q
        )

        # Decompose and set K & V with GQA pooling if needed
        if w_k.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size:
            self._decompose_and_set(
                self.key_u, self.key_s, self.key_vh, self.key_bias, w_k, b_k
            )
        else:
            rep = w_k.shape[0] // self.kv_head_size
            w_k_pooled = (
                w_k.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim, -1)
                .mean(dim=1)
                .view(self.kv_head_size, -1)
            )
            b_k_pooled = (
                b_k.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim).mean(dim=1).view(-1)
                if b_k is not None
                else None
            )
            self._decompose_and_set(
                self.key_u,
                self.key_s,
                self.key_vh,
                self.key_bias,
                w_k_pooled,
                b_k_pooled,
            )

        if w_v.shape[0] == self.kv_head_size:
            self._decompose_and_set(
                self.value_u, self.value_s, self.value_vh, self.value_bias, w_v, b_v
            )
        else:
            rep = w_v.shape[0] // self.kv_head_size
            w_v_pooled = (
                w_v.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim, -1)
                .mean(dim=1)
                .view(self.kv_head_size, -1)
            )
            b_v_pooled = (
                b_v.view(self.num_kv_heads, rep, self.head_dim).mean(dim=1).view(-1)
                if b_v is not None
                else None
            )
            self._decompose_and_set(
                self.value_u,
                self.value_s,
                self.value_vh,
                self.value_bias,
                w_v_pooled,
                b_v_pooled,
            )

        # Decompose and set Out projection (if not nested encoder)
        if w_o is not None and not self.is_nested_encoder:
            if torch.norm(w_o.float(), p="fro").item() < 1e-4:
                logger.warning("Copied out_proj weight has near-zero Frobenius norm (< 1e-4)")
            self._decompose_and_set(
                self.out_proj_u,
                self.out_proj_s,
                self.out_proj_vh,
                self.out_proj_bias,
                w_o,
                b_o,
            )
